When the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho facing him saw him, they said, “The spirit of Elijah rests on…
The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that Yahweh’s word in your mouth is truth.”

translations.web: Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.
translations.bsb: She came in, fell at his feet, and bowed to the ground. Then she picked up her son and went out.
